# Footbridges dossier

Sources about footbridges collected from four kinds of publisher, kept in separate folders:

1. `register/`  the official register (one entry per site)
2. `surveys/`   survey reports
3. `guides/`    published guidebooks
4. `news/`      newsletter items and press cuttings

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.

start.README.md:
# Windmills dossier

Sources about windmills collected from four kinds of publisher, kept in separate folders:

1. `register/`  the official register (one entry per site)
2. `surveys/`   survey reports
3. `guides/`    published guidebooks
4. `news/`      newsletter items and press cuttings

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.

# Reservoirs dossier

3. `guides/`    published guidebooks

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.

start.README.md:
# Windmills dossier

Sources about windmills collected from four kinds of publisher, kept in separate folders:

1. `register/`  the official register (one entry per site)
2. `surveys/`   survey reports
3. `guides/`    published guidebooks
4. `news/`      newsletter items and press cuttings

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.

start.README.md:
# Mountain huts dossier

Sources about mountain huts collected from four kinds of publisher, kept in separate folders:

1. `register/`  the official register (one entry per site)
2. `surveys/`   survey reports
3. `guides/`    published guidebooks
4. `news/`      newsletter items and press cuttings

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.

start.README.md:
# Lighthouses dossier

Sources about lighthouses collected from four kinds of publisher, kept in separate folders:

1. `register/`  the official register (one entry per site)
2. `surveys/`   survey reports
3. `guides/`    published guidebooks
4. `news/`      newsletter items and press cuttings

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.

start.README.md:
# Lighthouses dossier

Sources about lighthouses collected from four kinds of publisher, kept in separate folders:

1. `register/`  the official register (one entry per site)
2. `surveys/`   survey reports
3. `guides/`    published guidebooks
4. `news/`      newsletter items and press cuttings

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.

start.README.md:
# Lighthouses dossier

Sources about lighthouses collected from four kinds of publisher, kept in separate folders:

1. `register/`  the official register (one entry per site)
2. `surveys/`   survey reports
3. `guides/`    published guidebooks
4. `news/`      newsletter items and press cuttings

When sources disagree about a figure, use the highest-ranking source that states it (register over survey over
guidebook over newsletter). Among sources of the same rank, use the one with the latest date. A figure that a
higher-ranking source does not state falls back to the next rank down. Do not count votes: a repeated figure is not
more reliable than a single official one.
